name: ai4finance-foundation-finrl
title_zh: 用强化学习构建量化研究数据集与离线策略回测
tagline_zh: 不接实盘，只做研究：把行情数据变成 FinRL 风格的状态-动作样本，离线跑通训练-验证-交易全流程。
tagline_en: No live trading, just research: turn market data into FinRL-style state-action samples, run train-validate-trade.
desc_en: Build FinRL-inspired reinforcement-learning research datasets and offline strategy evaluations using QVeris-routed market data. Use for train-validate-trade experiments, state and reward design, risk controls, walk-forward evaluation, and paper-trading research without live order execution.
why_zh: 它把「数据管道」和「策略评估」焊死在一起——QVeris 路由的行情直接进状态设计。
why_en: It welds data pipeline to strategy evaluation—QVeris-routed market data flows straight into state design, no DIY CSV scrubbing.
limit_zh: 只认 QVeris 路由的行情格式，其他数据源得先自备转换器；只覆盖离线研究和 paper trading。
limit_en: Only accepts QVeris-routed market data; other sources need custom converters. Offline research and paper trading only—no live order execution.
